## VaultV2MorphoVaultV1Adapter.ids() method

**Signature:**

```typescript
ids(): readonly [adapterCapId: Hash];
```
**Returns:**

readonly \[adapterCapId: [Hash](./blue-sdk.hash.md)<!-- -->\]

A readonly tuple containing the adapter-wide allocation-cap id.
